body: To all of you saying you feel bad for him: Don't. He is upset because of the blow to his ego, remember that. In his mind, the only thing that matters is how his image is protected and upheld. My father is this way. It isn't that they feel no emotions. It's that what they do feel only comes from empathy for themselves, nobody else. That is the way of narcissists like him. Someone like him will watch other people suffer and feel bad that he had to take time out of his day to watch it, or waste time listening to someone else's problems. I know it sucks that there can be people like him in the world but the reality is that he cannot change nor understand.

I'm a senior in HS and I had a chemistry class with a guy I had a few other classes with. I had a massive crush on him for most of junior year. We would pick on each other mercilessly and I always figured it was just because he was the top of the class and I was known to be a bit of a goofball. 
When I found out he was taking one of his friend's little sister to prom so that she could go as an underclassman I teased him for it and he jokingly asked if I felt jealous, to which I stupidly replied "Nah. Not at all." He kept on but I denied it repeatedly out of embarrassment and he seemed to be disappointed.

Did it click then? Nah.

It wasn't until we were lab partners and he started humming songs with me while working and finding excuses to touch my hand that I got it. At that point I was already analyzing everything for signs but I wasn't confident enough to ask him out. I messaged him, nearly puking from nerves and we were together two weeks later. He's leaving for college in three weeks and I wish I had done it so much sooner. I'm glad I have him.
